target_cwe.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')
target_cwe.description: The product constructs all or part of an LDAP query using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the intended LDAP query when it is sent to a downstream component. Common in: sql_injection, input_validation.
target_cwe.impact: code execution, data access, data modification
remediation_steps: Use parameterized queries and prepared statements
Implement strict input validation with whitelisting

stage3_hypothesis.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')
